name: Embed Styler
author: SCUMSA
description: Restyle the manager's own embeds (kill feed, economy, status, leaderboard…) AND build your own auto-updating live embeds. Load any embed, change colour/title/author/image, replace fields, and drop in {tokens} for live data (squad, online players, top player, leaderboards…). Custom embeds refresh themselves in a channel like the built-in status. Built on the Discord Embed Editor.
